steps.name: Requirements phase

steps.name: Technical Specification phase
steps.description: Define the technical approach for scanning and generating specifications in spec.md.

steps.name: Planning phase
steps.description: Break down the work into concrete implementation tasks in plan.md.

steps.name: Generate core specifications (gateway, mcp, model)
steps.description: Generate detailed specs (requirements, design, tasks) for op-gateway, op-mcp, and op-dbus-model.

steps.name: Generate op-introspection specifications
steps.description: Analyze and generate specs for the op-introspection crate.

steps.name: Generate op-state-store specifications
steps.description: Analyze and generate specs for the op-state-store crate.

steps.name: Review and Finalize
steps.description: Perform a final consistency check across all generated specifications in .kiro/specs/.
